skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static command and reconnaissance hits are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline file paths, and generic documentation headings. The confirmed issue is that all three Python scripts can write JSON reports to an unconstrained user-supplied output path. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Unconstrained output file paths in helper scripts
remediation.suggestion: Resolve --output paths, restrict writes to the working project or a reports directory, and refuse overwrites unless the user passes an explicit force flag.

remediation.issue: Command examples are broad and include deployment commands
remediation.suggestion: Add a short safety note that dependency, Docker, and Kubernetes commands should be reviewed before use in production repositories.

content.user_title: Build Backend Services With Senior Review
content.value_statement: Backend teams need consistent guidance for APIs, databases, performance, and security. This skill provides scripts, checklists, and references for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides API design, database optimization, backend security, performance, and maintainability reviews.
Provides Python helper scripts that validate a target path and produce basic analysis reports.
Can write script results as formatted JSON when the user enables JSON output.
Documents common Node.js, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, test, and lint workflows.
Includes reference guides for API patterns, database optimization, and backend security practices.
limitations: The included scripts are starter templates and do not perform deep static analysis.
The load tester does not generate real traffic or benchmark live APIs.
The database migration tool does not inspect schemas or execute migrations.
Command examples require review before running in a real repository.

use_cases.title: Plan an API Surface
use_cases.description: Map resources, endpoints, validation rules, and review questions before implementing a REST or GraphQL backend.

use_cases.title: Review Database Changes
use_cases.description: Use the database guide to check migration risks, query patterns, indexing concerns, and rollback planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Service Readiness
use_cases.description: Combine security, testing, deployment, and performance checks into a backend launch review.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-backend skill to review this API plan. Check resource boundaries, validation, error handling, and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Backend Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a new service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-backend skill to create a checklist for a new backend service using my stack, database, and deployment target.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Database Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-backend skill to assess this database change plan. Identify migration risks, indexing needs, rollback steps, and observability checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-backend skill to review my service requirements, data model, auth constraints, and deployment target. Produce an implementation plan with risks, tests, and rollout checks.

output_examples.input: Review a REST API design for a payments service.
output_examples.output: A focused review covering endpoint boundaries, authentication, validation, idempotency, failure handling, and test gaps.

output_examples.input: Assess a database migration plan for a high-traffic table.
output: Migration risks are grouped by locking, rollback, indexing, and data integrity.
The response includes review questions and validation steps before release.

output_examples.input: Prepare a backend readiness checklist before launch.
output_examples.output: A launch checklist covering security controls, quality checks, monitoring, deployment commands, and post-release verification.

best_practices: Review command examples before running them in production repositories.
Provide target language, framework, database, and deployment constraints in each prompt.
Use the references as checklists, then validate results with project tests.
anti_patterns: Expecting the starter scripts to replace full test suites or profilers.
Running deployment or dependency commands without confirming the repository context.
Asking for broad architecture advice without sharing constraints or failure modes.

faq.question: Does this skill generate production backend code?
faq.answer: It guides backend planning and review. The included scripts are starter helpers, not complete service generators.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it run load tests against my API?
faq.answer: No. The load tester script currently validates a target path and produces a basic report template.

faq.question: Can it execute database migrations?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and a starter reporting script, but it does not execute migrations.

faq.question: Is it safe to run the helper scripts?
faq.answer: Review arguments first. The scripts can write report files when JSON output and an output path are provided.

faq.question: What backend topics does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers API patterns, database optimization, security practices, quality checks, performance, and maintainability.
